items.name: places-picker
items.title: Places Picker
items.description: Country, state and city in the reader's language, cascading so no query scans the world. Takes its language list as a prop, and its rows from any data layer.
items.docs: Pass a `client` that speaks the shadcn-places contract — `createPlacesClient()` from `shadcn-places/client`, a service binding, or fifteen lines of fetch. Pass `locales` to offer your own languages rather than the 898 the service holds, and `countries`/`subdivisions`/`cities` to drive it from TanStack Query or any other data layer. Installing and using this component is MIT; only redistributing the place DATABASE triggers ODbL. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.

items.name: places-coverage
items.title: Places Coverage
items.description: What the service actually has, per language, ranked by readers affected — plus the diagonal, which is the number a product serving one market lives on.
items.docs: Feed it `/api/locales?min=0&by=readers`. Two numbers per language and `latinScript` says which one means something — a single figure reports Spanish cities at 14% when a Spanish reader gets a correct name for 51% of them. Installing and using this component is MIT; only redistributing the place DATABASE triggers ODbL. See LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA.
